description: Xếp loại của công ty QLQ tại kỳ đánh giá gần nhất (1=A, 2=B, 3=C, 4=D)

'owner_equity_amt', 'BangCanDoiKeToan', '%báo cáo tài chính%', '400', 'Số cuối kỳ', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'charter_capital_amt', 'BangCanDoiKeToan', '%báo cáo tài chính%', '411', 'Số cuối kỳ', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'portfolio_management_contract_count', 'Chung_TinhHinhQLDMDT_06020', '%hoạt động%', '180101', 'Kỳ báo cáo', 0), target_cell AS (SELECT fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code, fmr_sheet.cell_id, kpi_spec.kpi_key, kpi_spec.bctc_ind, fund_management_report.version_nbr AS tpl_version FROM fmr_sheet INNER JOIN fund_management_report ON fund_management_report.fmr_id = fmr_sheet.fmr_id AND fund_management_report.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_TEMP' INNER JOIN kpi_spec ON kpi_spec.sheet_nm = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_nm AND LOWER(fund_management_report.fmr_nm) LIKE kpi_spec.rpt_nm_like WHERE fmr_sheet.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND (SELECT MAX(r.label_nm) FROM fmr_sheet r WHERE r.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND r.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND r.row_index = fmr_sheet.row_index AND r.column_index = (SELECT MIN(h.column_index) FROM fmr_sheet h WHERE h.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND h.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND h.label_nm = 'Mã chỉ tiêu' AND h.row_index = (SELECT MIN(m.row_index) FROM fmr_sheet m WHERE m.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND m.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET'))) = kpi_spec.row_code AND (SELECT STRING_AGG(lbl.label_nm, ' >> ' ORDER BY lbl.row_index, lbl.column_index) FROM fmr_sheet lbl WHERE lbl.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND lbl.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND lbl.cell_id <> fmr_sheet.cell_id AND lbl.label_nm IS NOT NULL AND lbl.row_index < fmr_sheet.row_index AND fmr_sheet.column_index BETWEEN lbl.column_index AND lbl.column_index + COALESCE(lbl.column_span, 1) - 1) = kpi_spec.col_label), submission_period AS (SELECT fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id, fmr_submission.fmc_id, fmr_submission.period_tp_code, fmr_submission.rpt_nm, fmr_submission.submitted_dt, CASE fmr_submission.period_tp_code WHEN '3' THEN LAST_DAY(MAKE_DATE(fmr_submission.rpt_year, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(fmr_submission.period_val, '^T(\d{2})/', 1), ''), fmr_submission.period_val) AS INT), 1)) WHEN '4' THEN LAST_DAY(MAKE_DATE(fmr_submission.rpt_year, 3 * CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(fmr_submission.period_val, '^Q(\d)/', 1), ''), fmr_submission.period_val) AS INT), 1)) WHEN '5' THEN MAKE_DATE(fmr_submission.rpt_year, 6, 30) WHEN '6' THEN MAKE_DATE(fmr_submission.rpt_year, 12, 31) END AS period_end_dt FROM fmr_submission WHERE fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' AND fmr_submission.record_tp = '2' AND fmr_submission.record_status_code IN ('2','3','5','10') AND fmr_submission.submitted_dt <= :etl_date), latest_val AS (SELECT submission_period.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(CAST(fmr_value.cell_val AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '%', '') DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY submission_period.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key ORDER BY submission_period.period_end_dt DESC, submission_period.period_tp_code DESC, target_cell.tpl_version DESC, CASE WHEN LOWER(submission_period.rpt_nm) LIKE '%kiểm toán%' OR LOWER(submission_period.rpt_nm) LIKE '%soát xét%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, submission_period.submitted_dt DESC) AS rn FROM fmr_value INNER JOIN submission_period ON submission_period.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id INNER JOIN target_cell ON target_cell.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND target_cell.cell_id = fmr_value.cell_id WHERE fmr_value.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND ((target_cell.bctc_ind = 0 AND submission_period.period_tp_code = '3') OR (target_cell.bctc_ind = 1 AND submission_period.period_tp_code IN ('4','5','6') AND submission_period.period_end_dt <= :etl_date))), latest_report AS (SELECT fmc_id, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'certified_practitioner_staff_count' THEN val END) AS certified_practitioner_staff_count, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'assets_under_management_amt' THEN val END) AS assets_under_management_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'capital_adequacy_ratio' THEN val END) AS capital_adequacy_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'net_profit_after_tax_amt' THEN val END) AS net_profit_after_tax_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'owner_equity_amt' THEN val END) AS owner_equity_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'charter_capital_amt' THEN val END) AS charter_capital_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'portfolio_management_contract_count' THEN val END) AS portfolio_management_contract_count FROM latest_val WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY fmc_id) LEFT JOIN latest_report ON latest_report.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id → latest_report.charter_capital_amt

AS bctc_ind UNION ALL SELECT 'assets_under_management_amt', 'HDQuanLyQuy_06014', '%hoạt động%', '170103', 'Tổng', 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'capital_adequacy_ratio', 'BangTongHop_06013', '%an toàn tài chính%', '4055', 'Giá trị rủi ro/ vốn khả dụng', 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'net_profit_after_tax_amt', 'BCKetQuaHoatDongKinhDoanh', '%báo cáo tài chính%', '60', 'Kỳ này', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'owner_equity_amt', 'BangCanDoiKeToan', '%báo cáo tài chính%', '400', 'Số cuối kỳ', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'charter_capital_amt', 'BangCanDoiKeToan', '%báo cáo tài chính%', '411', 'Số cuối kỳ', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'portfolio_management_contract_count', 'Chung_TinhHinhQLDMDT_06020', '%hoạt động%', '180101', 'Kỳ báo cáo', 0), target_cell AS (SELECT fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code, fmr_sheet.cell_id, kpi_spec.kpi_key, kpi_spec.bctc_ind, fund_management_report.version_nbr AS tpl_version FROM fmr_sheet INNER JOIN fund_management_report ON fund_management_report.fmr_id = fmr_sheet.fmr_id AND fund_management_report.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_TEMP' INNER JOIN kpi_spec ON kpi_spec.sheet_nm = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_nm AND LOWER(fund_management_report.fmr_nm) LIKE kpi_spec.rpt_nm_like WHERE fmr_sheet.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND (SELECT MAX(r.label_nm) FROM fmr_sheet r WHERE r.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND r.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND r.row_index = fmr_sheet.row_index AND r.column_index = (SELECT MIN(h.column_index) FROM fmr_sheet h WHERE h.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND h.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND h.label_nm = 'Mã chỉ tiêu' AND h.row_index = (SELECT MIN(m.row_index) FROM fmr_sheet m WHERE m.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND m.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET'))) = kpi_spec.row_code AND (SELECT STRING_AGG(lbl.label_nm, ' >> ' ORDER BY lbl.row_index, lbl.column_index) FROM fmr_sheet lbl WHERE lbl.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND lbl.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND lbl.cell_id <> fmr_sheet.cell_id AND lbl.label_nm IS NOT NULL AND lbl.row_index < fmr_sheet.row_index AND fmr_sheet.column_index BETWEEN lbl.column_index AND lbl.column_index + COALESCE(lbl.column_span, 1) - 1) = kpi_spec.col_label), submission_period AS (SELECT fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id, fmr_submission.fmc_id, fmr_submission.period_tp_code, fmr_submission.rpt_nm, fmr_submission.submitted_dt, CASE AS INT), 1)) WHEN '4' THEN LAST_DAY(MAKE_DATE(fmr_submission.rpt_year, 3 * CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(fmr_submission.period_val, '^Q(\d)/', 1), ''), fmr_submission.period_val) AS INT), 1)) WHEN '5' THEN MAKE_DATE(fmr_submission.rpt_year, 6, 30) WHEN '6' THEN MAKE_DATE(fmr_submission.rpt_year, 12, 31) END AS period_end_dt FROM fmr_submission WHERE fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' AND fmr_submission.record_tp = '2' AND fmr_submission.record_status_code IN ('2','3','5','10') AND fmr_submission.submitted_dt <= :etl_date), latest_val AS (SELECT submission_period.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(CAST(fmr_value.cell_val AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '%', '') DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY submission_period.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key ORDER BY submission_period.period_end_dt DESC, submission_period.period_tp_code DESC, target_cell.tpl_version DESC, CASE WHEN LOWER(submission_period.rpt_nm) LIKE '%kiểm toán%' OR LOWER(submission_period.rpt_nm) LIKE '%soát xét%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, submission_period.submitted_dt DESC) AS rn FROM fmr_value INNER JOIN submission_period ON submission_period.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id INNER JOIN target_cell ON target_cell.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND target_cell.cell_id = fmr_value.cell_id WHERE fmr_value.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND ((target_cell.bctc_ind = 0 AND submission_period.period_tp_code = '3') OR (target_cell.bctc_ind = 1 AND submission_period.period_tp_code IN ('4','5','6') AND submission_period.period_end_dt <= :etl_date))), latest_report AS (SELECT fmc_id, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'certified_practitioner_staff_count' THEN val END) AS certified_practitioner_staff_count, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'assets_under_management_amt' THEN val END) AS assets_under_management_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'capital_adequacy_ratio' THEN val END) AS capital_adequacy_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'net_profit_after_tax_amt' THEN val END) AS net_profit_after_tax_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'owner_equity_amt' THEN val END) AS owner_equity_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'charter_capital_amt' THEN val END) AS charter_capital_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'portfolio_management_contract_count' THEN val END) AS portfolio_management_contract_count FROM latest_val WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY fmc_id) LEFT JOIN latest_report ON latest_report.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id → latest_report.capital_adequacy_ratio

'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' AND fmr_submission.record_tp = '2' AND fmr_submission.record_status_code IN ('2','3','5','10') AND fmr_submission.submitted_dt <= :etl_date), latest_val AS (SELECT submission_period.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(CAST(fmr_value.cell_val AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '%', '') DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY submission_period.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key ORDER BY submission_period.period_end_dt DESC, submission_period.period_tp_code DESC, target_cell.tpl_version DESC, CASE WHEN submission_period ON submission_period.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id INNER JOIN target_cell ON target_cell.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND target_cell.cell_id = fmr_value.cell_id WHERE fmr_value.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND ((target_cell.bctc_ind = 0 AND submission_period.period_tp_code = '3') OR (target_cell.bctc_ind = 1 AND submission_period.period_tp_code IN ('4','5','6') AND submission_period.period_end_dt <= :etl_date))), latest_report AS (SELECT fmc_id, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'certified_practitioner_staff_count' THEN val END) AS certified_practitioner_staff_count, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'assets_under_management_amt' THEN val END) AS assets_under_management_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'capital_adequacy_ratio' THEN val END) AS capital_adequacy_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'net_profit_after_tax_amt' THEN val END) AS net_profit_after_tax_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'owner_equity_amt' THEN val END) AS owner_equity_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'charter_capital_amt' THEN val END) AS charter_capital_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'portfolio_management_contract_count' THEN val END) AS portfolio_management_contract_count FROM latest_val WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY fmc_id) LEFT JOIN latest_report ON latest_report.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id →
